exposure.primary: Third-agent adjudication exposed to the completed A and B annotations and raw reviews, their uncertainties, and parent summaries of agreement and differences before any detector predictions. Decisions used published contracts and permitted original source context. No implementation, tests, detector predictions/reports, old review sessions or reserved holdout were read. Reviewed Python modules were not executed or imported.

C004 TODO span difference and MockRequest.add_header contract ambiguity

auxiliary.incident: A delegated read-only coverage checker reported printing the full native-context JSON rather than the bounded inventory/sources/targets extraction. This also displayed references and excluded_destinations structural fields. The checker was interrupted; its source recommendations were discarded and did not contribute to labels. No field values or findings from that overread were conveyed to the primary adjudicator.
auxiliary.root_disposition: Root authorized the primary adjudicator to continue while disclosing this auxiliary exposure. The primary adjudicator independently extracted only the permitted native_context sections and used setup.md original text.
auxiliary.exposure_receipt: The interrupted child supplied only exact displayed field paths and an exposure audit, with no field values, link findings, source advice or recommendations. It reported no detector implementation, predictions, score reports or detector-run results displayed, and no further inspection after the exposure-audit instruction.
